images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop screenshot of the planned Sandbox Connect admin CPU/GPU dashboard, using synthetic sample data.
Create a crisp, flat, polished web UI screenshot, landscape about 1600 x 1000, fully readable text, no perspective, no laptop or decorative props. Simple shippable admin interface, restrained light background, white panels, thin gray borders, generous whitespace, dark readable text, clean sans-serif typography. CPU uses blue and GPU uses teal consistently. No huge sidebar or decorative illustrations; one small top navigation with "Sandbox Connect" and "Sandbox usage", admin role label "COS admin".
Header "Sandbox usage", subtitle "Primary sandbox cluster", freshness "Updated 15:30 IST", small "Sample data" badge. Controls: segmented "All" (selected), "CPU", "GPU"; date dropdown "Last 7 days"; date text "6–12 Oct 2026 · IST".
Four equal overview cards in this exact order: "Running CPU sandboxes" value "4" small "Now"; "Running GPU sandboxes" value "2" small "Now"; "Recorded CPU session hours" value "60.5 h" small "Selected period"; "Recorded GPU session hours" value "31.25 h" small "Selected period". Do not shorten recorded session hours to utilization.
Below cards a discreet text strip: "3 running users" · "3 users with sessions" · "Requested CPU: 8.5 cores" · "Requested memory: 20 GiB" · "Requested GPU: 2 nvidia.com/gpu". Secondary compact status line "6 running · 2 stopped · 1 opening · 1 failed".
One grouped bar chart titled "Daily session hours", subtitle "Recorded booking sessions", legend "CPU" blue and "GPU" teal. Seven day labels "6 Oct", "7 Oct", "8 Oct", "9 Oct", "10 Oct", "11 Oct", "12 Oct". Y axis label "Hours" ticks 0,5,10. First six days CPU bars 10 GPU bars 5; last day CPU 0.5 GPU 1.25. Last day is partial. Do not add utilization percentages, cost, credits, device-hours, capacity, forecasts, trend arrows or invented features.
Users table title "Usage by user"; search input placeholder "Search users"; columns exactly "User", "Running CPU", "Running GPU", "CPU hours", "GPU hours".
Three sample rows: "asha@example.com" | 2 | 1 | 24 | 16; "naveen@example.com" | 1 | 1 | 20 | 10; "priya@example.com" | 1 | 0 | 16.5 | 5.25. Email domains are synthetic. Small footer "3 users" and "20 per page". All hours/cards/table totals must agree.
Subtle final note "Session hours cover recorded booking sessions. Resource values are requests." No API names, implementation details, tokens or URLs in the product UI. No credit info anywhere.
Primary request: Render the normal overview screen with the cards, supporting strip, daily chart, and complete users table visible. Well-spaced one-page composition. Focus on calm visual hierarchy and simple dashboard controls. No side panel open.
